name: One-tap repeat set
description: Copy the previous set, then adjust only what changed; keep warm-up and working-set types distinct.

name: Undo recent actions
description: Restore a removed set, exercise or completion mark through a visible undo action and a short action history.

name: Supersets and circuits
description: Group exercises, alternate between them and start the appropriate rest timer after the whole round.

name: Mid-session exercise swaps
description: Replace a lift through the searchable library, preserving the original prescription and recording the reason for the swap.

name: Per-exercise rest presets
description: Save default rest times for each exercise and allow a quick change during a session.

name: Screen-stays-awake option
description: Request a screen wake lock during logging, show whether it is active and recover gracefully when the browser releases it.

name: Warm-up set builder
description: Calculate editable warm-up ramps from the planned working load and round loads to equipment you actually have.

name: Session pause and resume
description: Separate active training time from paused time and restore both after navigation or a reload.

name: Set-type labels
description: Add drop-set, back-off, tempo and assisted-set labels without counting them as identical straight sets in every chart.

name: Unilateral side tracking
description: Give left and right sides independent entries, plus a combined view when that suits the exercise.

name: Session completion recap
description: Show duration, completed work, volume and new records, with a final edit screen before finishing.

name: Accidental-exit protection
description: Warn before abandoning unsaved work, visibly confirm draft recovery and keep a clear route back to the session.

name: Rolling workout rotation
description: Run A/B/C or any repeating sequence independent of weekdays; suggest the next template when starting.

name: Training blocks
description: Organise several weeks into blocks with start/end dates, optional goals and a simple archive.

name: Template folders and tags
description: Group unlimited templates by gym, goal or training phase, with search and favourites.

name: Template duplication
description: Copy a session, rename it and edit it without changing the original or its past workouts.

name: Version history for templates
description: Compare previous template versions and restore one while keeping completed sessions unchanged.

name: Optional scheduling
description: Offer scheduled, rolling and choose-on-the-day modes with no compulsory weekday assignment.

name: Exercise substitution rules
description: Save preferred alternatives by equipment or movement, then let the lifter approve the actual swap.

name: Rep-range prescriptions
description: Support different targets for each set instead of one range for the whole exercise.

name: Training-day target types
description: Allow strength, technique, volume or recovery sessions to carry different defaults and check-in prompts.

name: Deload template copies
description: Create an editable lighter copy from a chosen programme and keep it separate from the original plan.

name: Programme checkpoints
description: Attach review dates and notes to a block so adjustments happen deliberately rather than automatically.

name: Share a template privately
description: Send a read-only template link or export that another authorised user can copy into their own library.

name: Equipment and muscle filters
description: Combine equipment, movement, muscle and difficulty filters instead of searching only by name.

name: Favourite exercises
description: Pin frequently used lifts and show them first when adding exercises to a workout.

name: Personal exercise aliases
description: Match familiar names, abbreviations and spelling variations to the same exercise history.

name: Custom exercise images
description: Attach a small self-made image to a custom exercise, respecting the shared media cap.

name: Beginner cue cards
description: Show short setup, execution and common-error notes beside an exercise, with a link to the full guide.

name: Movement-pattern browsing
description: Browse squats, hinges, horizontal pulls and other patterns when the user does not know an exercise name.

name: Gym-specific equipment lists
description: Record which machines and implements exist at each gym and filter exercises accordingly.

name: Equipment setup notes
description: Remember seat position, cable height, grips and machine settings for a particular gym and exercise.

name: Range-of-motion notes
description: Save an individual's chosen range and technique cue without presenting it as a universal prescription.

name: Manual video comparison
description: Play two short saved clips side by side, with pause and slow playback; provide no automated form judgement.

name: Reference-video bookmarks
description: Save an external instructional link and optional timestamp without downloading or analysing the video.

name: Library corrections workflow
description: Let users propose a duplicate, wrong muscle tag or inaccurate cue; let the owner review changes before publication.

name: Exercise-specific trend pages
description: Combine load, reps and completed-set history with date filters and readable mobile charts.

name: Rep-range personal records
description: Track separate records for singles, five-rep sets, ten-rep sets and other user-selected ranges.

name: Estimated max transparency
description: Show the chosen estimated-max formula and the sets used, and distinguish estimates from tested records.

name: Rolling volume trends
description: Compare completed sets and load-volume over rolling periods rather than calendar weeks alone.

name: Muscle-volume drill-down
description: Tap a muscle on the diagram to see contributing exercises, set counts and date ranges.

name: Direct and indirect set views
description: Show separate configurable models for direct and secondary work without calling either measured activation.

name: Progression rule editor
description: Let users define rep ceilings, load jumps and repeat-session rules; coaches approve changes where relevant.

name: Plateau review prompts
description: Flag a chosen number of comparable sessions without progress and show the underlying records for review.

name: Technique-change annotations
description: Mark a new range, machine or execution style so graphs do not silently compare incompatible performances.

name: Left-right trend comparison
description: Compare unilateral sides over time and show the actual sets behind any difference.

name: Bodyweight-adjusted strength
description: Offer load-to-bodyweight views using dated weigh-ins, with clear treatment of missing weigh-ins.

name: Data-quality controls
description: Exclude warm-ups, assisted reps or invalid entries from a chart, while retaining the original records.

name: Interval session builder
description: Build repeatable work/rest intervals for running, cycling, rowing or other cardio.

name: Manual lap splits
description: Record lap or kilometre splits, then compare consistency across similar sessions.

name: Comparable-distance PBs
description: Separate 5 km, 10 km and other benchmarks and show time and speed improvement correctly.

name: Speed versus pace display
description: Toggle km/h, min/km and min/mile with consistent conversion throughout the cardio pages.

name: Perceived-effort logging
description: Add a simple effort score and notes so casual cardio can be tracked without a heart-rate device.

name: Incline and elevation notes
description: Record treadmill incline, stairs climbed or manually entered elevation as distinct fields.

name: Weekly cardio totals
description: Summarise time, distance and session count by activity without combining unlike units into a fake score.

name: Personal heart-rate zones
description: Allow manually supplied zone boundaries and label them as user settings, not automatic medical thresholds.

name: Walk-run progression plans
description: Provide editable interval templates and completion tracking without dynamically prescribing intensity.

name: Routes from GPX files
description: Import a route with a preview and privacy controls; calculate distance using a documented method.

name: Foreground GPS recording
description: Optionally record while the page is active, show permission/status and warn when recording is interrupted.

name: Indoor benchmark history
description: Track repeatable bike, rower or treadmill tests with equipment identifiers to improve comparability.

name: Copy a previous day
description: Choose which meals to copy into a new date, preview the result and prevent accidental duplicate imports.

name: Food favourites and recents
description: Rank personal staples, hide unwanted recent items and search them alongside saved foods.

name: Flexible serving units
description: Save grams, millilitres and household units with explicit conversion factors per food.

name: Per-100-gram entry mode
description: Enter label nutrition once and calculate any weighed portion automatically.

name: Custom meal categories
description: Rename, reorder or add meal groups without changing their historic dates or contents.

name: Saved-food portion matching
description: Rank saved portions against remaining macros and calories, with no generated or invented food values.

name: Fibre tracking
description: Add fibre as an optional field, source it from labels and show unknown values as unknown.

name: Optional micronutrient fields
description: Track selected nutrients only when the product data or user actually supplies those values.

name: Recipe nutrition versioning
description: Keep logged servings tied to the recipe version used on that date when ingredients later change.

name: Training and rest-day targets
description: Apply chosen calorie/macro targets by day type while preserving historical targets for comparison.

name: Food-source labels
description: Show whether nutrition came from a package, public database, recipe calculation or manual estimate.

name: Diary validation and undo
description: Flag implausible portions, distinguish missing from zero and offer undo after food deletion.

name: Recipe folders and search
description: Organise recipes by meal, preparation time or personal tag without imposing a template-count limit.

name: Cooked and raw weight modes
description: Record which weight basis each ingredient uses and avoid silently converting raw values to cooked values.

name: Batch-cooking portions
description: Record final cooked batch weight and log a serving by grams or fraction of the batch.

name: Scaled recipes
description: Scale ingredient amounts and servings together while retaining the original recipe.

name: Ingredient substitutions
description: Save user-approved swaps with their own nutrition data and show the effect on calculated macros.

name: Pantry inventory
description: Mark ingredients already owned so grocery lists omit or reduce them appropriately.

name: Consolidated shopping lists
description: Combine matching ingredients across planned recipes and keep units compatible before summing.

name: Manual recipe cost estimates
description: Enter ingredient prices to calculate a batch cost and cost per serving, without live supermarket APIs.

name: Meal-prep calendar
description: Arrange saved recipes across dates and log the actual meal separately from the plan.

name: Dietary preference tags
description: Filter user-tagged recipes by preferences; never imply unverified allergy safety.

name: Printable prep sheets
description: Export a compact recipe, scaled ingredients and shopping list as a browser-generated printable sheet.

name: Recipe copy and private sharing
description: Share a recipe with an authorised friend who can copy and modify it independently.

name: Measurement reminders
description: Offer user-chosen weigh-in times and an easy skip, using supported reminder methods.

name: Measurement edit history
description: Show corrections and their dates so an accidental weight entry can be traced and reversed.

name: Waist and circumference charts
description: Track waist, arms, chest or other chosen measurements with custom units and notes.

name: Goal-direction choices
description: Support maintain, gain or lose goals without treating a falling weight as automatically better.

name: Target-weight range
description: Allow a maintenance band instead of requiring one exact goal weight.

name: Projection versus reality
description: Overlay scenario checkpoints against actual measurements and show the size of the difference.

name: Body-fat uncertainty range
description: Accept a manually entered range and show how that changes checkpoint weights and FFMI.

name: Multiple weight-trend methods
description: Offer a clearly labelled moving average or smoothing method, with a stable default and consistent history.

name: Progress-photo alignment
description: Add a manual positioning guide and consistent view labels; keep small files under the media cap.

name: Observed maintenance diagnostics
description: Show which intake and weight records support the estimate and why it may be unavailable.

name: Goal review dates
description: Schedule manual reviews so targets can be revised instead of blindly following an old timeline.

name: Body-progress summary export
description: Create a private printable summary of trends, measurements and milestones for a chosen period.

name: Manual sleep schedule log
description: Record bedtime, wake time, naps and subjective sleep quality when no wearable export is available.

name: Sleep consistency view
description: Show variability in bed and wake times across the user's chosen date range.

name: Personal baseline windows
description: Compare HRV or resting heart rate with the person's own recent records, using consistent data sources.

name: Recovery journal tags
description: Record travel, late training or other user-selected context and browse trends without claiming causation.

name: Rest-day notes
description: Log rest and recovery activities without needing to invent an exercise session.

name: Source-specific sleep charts
description: Separate wearable sources and manual entries rather than merging conflicting stage readings.

name: Naps and overnight attribution
description: Handle naps separately and make the date assigned to an overnight sleep period explicit.

name: User-defined sleep goals
description: Allow schedule-based targets and show actual versus chosen target without diagnosing sleep disorders.

name: Fatigue check-in trends
description: Chart the user's energy, stress and soreness logs alongside training without prescribing a medical response.

name: Transparent readiness checklist
description: Use an optional rule-based checklist with disclosed weights and missing-data handling, not a claimed clinical recovery score.

name: Recovery and performance comparison
description: Compare sleep/fatigue logs with later sessions, label small samples and avoid cause-and-effect claims.

name: Recovery source diagnostics
description: Show missing dates, source changes and stale records before displaying a confident-looking graph.

name: Custom daily habits
description: Let users add a small checklist such as prepare gym bag, stretch or log food.

name: Weekly frequency goals
description: Track three sessions per week or similar targets without requiring fixed weekdays.

name: Flexible streaks
description: Offer weekly consistency streaks, planned rest days and optional grace days rather than daily all-or-nothing streaks.

name: Quiet hours
description: Respect user-selected sleep and work periods whenever reminders can be delivered.

name: Reminder delivery status
description: Show whether a reminder is calendar-only, foreground-only or supported push, and when it last succeeded.

name: Snooze and reschedule
description: Let a user defer a workout or check-in without duplicating the scheduled task.

name: Habit templates
description: Provide editable checklists for training days, rest days and meal preparation.

name: Weekly reflection prompts
description: Ask what went well, what got in the way and what should change next week.

name: Minimum-session option
description: Save a shorter fallback workout for busy days and mark it separately from a full session.

name: Milestone reminders
description: Offer an optional review reminder for a saved goal date instead of declaring the goal achieved automatically.

name: Closed-app web push
description: Add only after confirming Sites can run a sender, with opt-in permission, quiet hours and delivery testing.

name: Pause reminders temporarily
description: Disable reminders during illness, holidays or a chosen break without deleting the underlying plan.

name: Custom quick actions
description: Choose the main Home buttons, such as Start workout, Add food, Log weight and Add cardio.

name: Unified selected date
description: Keep one clearly visible selected date across Home, food and progress screens, with a return-to-today action.

name: Continue-last-task card
description: Resume the unfinished workout, incomplete food entry or selected planning task from Home.

name: Global search
description: Search templates, exercises, recipes, friends and settings with result types clearly separated.

name: Pinned pages
description: Let users pin their most-used pages and keep advanced sections collapsed until needed.

name: First-week checklist
description: Guide a new user through profile, first template, first log and first backup.

name: Meaningful empty states
description: Explain why a chart has no data and give one direct action to start collecting it.

name: Consistent back navigation
description: Preserve search, scroll and selected date when returning from a detail page.

name: Dashboard layout presets
description: Offer compact, nutrition-focused and training-focused presets alongside manual card customisation.

name: Phone layout test matrix
description: Verify narrow screens, large text, landscape mode and keyboard-open forms before each release.

name: Help beside complex numbers
description: Explain trend rate, expenditure, FFMI and volume calculations at the point where each appears.

name: Home performance budget
description: Set limits for initial scripts, image sizes and unnecessary requests, then measure on a slower phone.

name: Post audience controls
description: Choose private, selected friends or all accepted friends for each post, with a clear preview.

name: Block and mute
description: Hide unwanted content and stop contact through an explicit block or temporary mute.

name: Friend groups
description: Create small groups such as gym mates or a training partner, without making profiles public.

name: Optional activity visibility
description: Choose whether friends see workout completion, exercise detail or only a manually shared summary.

name: Post edit history
description: Correct a caption or shared set summary while preserving enough history to explain the change.

name: Reactions beyond likes
description: Offer a small set of reactions that users can disable, avoiding unnecessary social pressure.

name: Comment controls
description: Edit/delete your own comment and let a post author close comments or remove abusive replies.

name: Mentions and notifications
description: Notify only authorised users and avoid exposing a private post through notification text.

name: Training-partner check-ins
description: Send an in-app acknowledgement or optional plan to meet, without accessing an external messaging service.

name: Feed filters
description: Filter friends' sessions, milestones or photos and hide categories the user does not want.

name: Shareable workout cards
description: Generate an image or printable card locally with the exact fields the user approves.

name: Report and remove workflow
description: Let a small-group owner review reported posts, with audit records and no automatic publication of reports.

name: Consistency challenges
description: Compete on completing a personal weekly plan rather than absolute workout volume.

name: Personal improvement scoring
description: Compare percentage improvement against each participant's baseline for an agreed metric.

name: Challenge rule preview
description: Show eligibility, date range, scoring formula and tie rules before anyone joins.

name: Team goals
description: Let a group combine completed sessions, active minutes or another compatible measure toward a shared target.

name: Baseline confirmation
description: Require participants to review their own starting measurement and units before a challenge begins.

name: Private proof attachments
description: Optionally attach a short clip or record visible only to agreed reviewers, respecting media limits.

name: Anti-duplicate scoring
description: Prevent the same imported or edited activity from earning points multiple times.

name: Minimum-data rules
description: Label insufficient records and exclude missing values instead of treating them as zero performance.

name: Achievement badges
description: Award optional badges for personal milestones, with a way to hide celebrations.

name: Challenge pause or exit
description: Let users leave or pause a challenge with clearly defined effects on the leaderboard.

name: Accessible alternatives
description: Offer comparable completion-based targets when participants have different equipment or abilities.

name: Challenge recap
description: Summarise each person's progress and consistency without declaring a universal fitness ranking.

name: Attention queue filters
description: Separate missed logs, overdue check-ins and stalled trends, with configurable thresholds.

name: Coach task list
description: Assign follow-up tasks to yourself with due dates and completion notes.

name: Scheduled programme reviews
description: Attach review dates to clients or blocks and show them in the attention queue.

name: Bulk assignment preview
description: Show exactly which clients and plans will change before a multi-client template assignment.

name: Client-specific overrides
description: Assign a shared template but customise one client's sets, equipment or progression rules independently.

name: Check-in form builder
description: Choose a small set of questions for each client instead of forcing every available metric.

name: Coach-only note labels
description: Make private notes visibly distinct from messages that the client can see.

name: Reviewable change proposals
description: Let coaches propose programme changes, show differences and request the client's acknowledgement.

name: Video feedback timestamps
description: Attach a written coaching note to a moment in an uploaded short clip without automated analysis.

name: Consent and access history
description: Show who has access, when consent was given and how to disconnect.

name: Client progress brief
description: Produce a chosen-date summary of adherence, training and trends for a check-in meeting.

name: Coach personal workspace
description: Make switching between your own training and client review clear, fast and hard to confuse.

name: Import mapping wizard
description: Preview columns and let users map unfamiliar exercise, meal and date fields before saving.

name: Dry-run import report
description: Show accepted rows, rejected rows, duplicates and unit conversions before changing records.

name: Import rollback batches
description: Attach an import ID to new records so a mistaken import can be undone without deleting unrelated history.

name: Duplicate resolution
description: Let users choose between skip, keep both or merge when imported records conflict.

name: Exercise-name matching
description: Suggest catalogue matches with a review screen and remember the user's mappings for future imports.

name: Full personal export
description: Export templates, sessions, foods, measurements and relevant metadata in a documented portable format.

name: Media export manifest
description: List saved media and filenames with authenticated download links, distinct from the smaller data export.

name: Import progress and resume
description: Process large files in bounded batches, show progress and safely resume after interruptions.

name: Locale-aware parsing
description: Detect date, decimal and unit conventions and ask the user to confirm ambiguous cases.

name: Source and correction metadata
description: Retain the original source and record later corrections without silently rewriting provenance.

name: Versioned export schema
description: Include format versions and migration rules so future app updates can still read old backups.

name: Backup reminder and test restore
description: Remind users to export periodically and offer a harmless validation of a chosen backup file.

name: True offline app shell
description: Cache the minimum app shell and offline fallback, while keeping private content out of shared public caches.

name: IndexedDB workout drafts
description: Store active-session drafts with schema versions and recovery metadata rather than relying only on localStorage.

name: Visible sync queue
description: Show pending saves, last successful sync and the action needed when a record fails.

name: Conflict-resolution screen
description: Compare local and server changes when two devices edit the same record, instead of silently overwriting.

name: Idempotent saves everywhere
description: Extend duplicate-safe retries beyond workouts to meals, measurements, comments and imports.

name: Reconnect recovery
description: Resume uploads or queued records on return to the foreground; background sync is an enhancement only where supported.

name: Storage-eviction warnings
description: Explain device storage risks and offer an export before clearing drafts or installing an update.

name: Interrupted-upload handling
description: Avoid orphaned media and make a failed upload clearly recoverable or removable.

name: Safe app updates
description: Avoid replacing the app underneath an active workout; offer an update after the session is saved.

name: Single-active-session guard
description: Detect multiple tabs or devices editing a session and ask how to proceed before conflicting saves.

name: Time-zone consistency tests
description: Keep session dates, sleep dates, reminders and streak boundaries correct when travelling or crossing midnight.

name: Readable failure states
description: Explain an expired login, quota limit, server error or offline state without pretending the save succeeded.

name: Large-text layout
description: Support system text scaling and a larger in-app reading size without clipping forms or tables.

name: Screen-reader workflow
description: Label live-set inputs, announce save/error states and keep a sensible reading order.

name: Keyboard-only operation
description: Make exercise search, logging, menus and dialogs fully usable without touch or a mouse.

name: High-contrast palette
description: Offer a contrast-tested theme and never rely on colour alone for success, trends or selected controls.

name: Reduced-motion preference
description: Respect the system setting and provide an explicit control for celebrations or animated charts.

name: Left-handed quick controls
description: Allow important actions to sit within comfortable reach without changing data semantics.

name: Custom display units
description: Set kg/lb, distance, pace, water and date conventions consistently across pages and exports.

name: Adaptive number entry
description: Use appropriate numeric keyboards, sensible increments and clear decimal handling for each measurement.

name: One-hand session mode
description: Prioritise the active exercise and next action with large targets and fewer secondary controls.

name: Optional sound and vibration
description: Offer supported feedback without requiring it; keep visual confirmation when device APIs are unavailable.

name: Plain-language metric help
description: Explain formulas and controls in short, readable text, with an advanced detail view when needed.

name: Translation-ready text
description: Centralise labels, dates and units so additional languages can be added without rewriting every screen.

name: Privacy dashboard
description: List stored data types, coaches/friends with access and the controls for changing visibility.

name: Granular sharing consent
description: Separate workout, nutrition, measurement and photo sharing instead of one unclear all-data toggle.

name: Delete-my-data workflow
description: Explain scope, require confirmation and delete the user's records and media without affecting other accounts.

name: Session/device controls
description: Show available sign-in/device status and link to the platform controls for revocation where supported.

name: Private-by-default social
description: Keep new posts, measurements and profiles private until the user deliberately chooses an audience.

name: Media retention choices
description: Offer expiry dates or cleanup suggestions for old clips/photos while excluding records the user wants to keep.

name: Privacy-safe diagnostic logs
description: Record failures without storing passwords, tokens, health payloads or uploaded photos in operational logs.

name: Cross-account isolation tests
description: Continuously test that a friend, former coach or stranger cannot read or modify another user's records.

name: Input and upload hardening
description: Keep size/signature validation, schema checks and safe rendering consistent across every endpoint.

name: Opt-out from comparisons
description: Let users hide strength comparisons, body metrics and competitive features without losing basic logging.

name: Account-access recovery guide
description: Explain how to recover the underlying Sites sign-in and what app records remain available after recovery.

name: Data-use explanation
description: Provide a concise policy stating what is stored, who can see it and that this edition does not send data to AI.

name: Health import centre
description: Combine supported file formats, examples, date ranges and a preview in one place.

name: Source-priority rules
description: Let users choose which source wins for steps, sleep or weight when several devices overlap.

name: Duplicate interval detection
description: Detect overlapping sleep or activity intervals before summing totals.

name: Metric unit normalisation
description: Convert only known unit pairs and reject ambiguous ones rather than guessing.

name: Missing-data calendar
description: Show which dates have readings and distinguish an absent reading from a genuine zero.

name: Import presets per provider
description: Provide reviewed mappings for specific export versions without claiming live connections to those services.

name: Total-versus-active energy rules
description: Clearly identify totals, active calories and basal calories, and prevent expenditure double counting.

name: Optional manual metric entry
description: Allow a dated reading with unit and source when a device export is unavailable.

name: Correct and undo health imports
description: Review an imported batch, fix its source/date mapping or remove it safely.

name: Metric reference sources
description: Attach source/version/cohort information to any published reference bands and distinguish wearable estimates from tests.

name: Data freshness indicators
description: Display when records were imported and how old the latest measurement is.

name: Connection permissions review
description: List optional connections, explain their scope and offer a verified disconnect/revocation path.

name: Usage and quota dashboard
description: Show app-controlled media usage and available platform limits without claiming visibility into billing the app cannot read.

name: Media cleanup manager
description: List the user's largest/oldest files, support preview and offer safe deletion with clear size savings.

name: Release checklist
description: Require checks for sign-in, logging, imports, isolation and mobile layout before publishing an update.

name: Restore rehearsal
description: Validate backup integrity and practise recovery in a separate test environment before an incident.

name: Stable import/export contracts
description: Keep compatibility fixtures so a change cannot silently break old exports or saved templates.

name: Schema migration review
description: Inspect bounded, additive migrations and document rollback or forward-fix steps before deployment.

name: Small-group access manager
description: Show the difference between Sites viewer access, Form friendship and coaching consent.

name: Feature flags
description: Release larger features to a small test group first and keep a safe way to disable a broken enhancement.

name: Performance regression checks
description: Measure heavy diary/history pages with larger test datasets and avoid unnecessary repeated requests.

name: Storage and query budgets
description: Bound expensive lists/import batches and monitor indexed queries so small-group use stays efficient.

name: No-paid-service guard
description: Check code/configuration for reintroduced AI calls, R2 bindings or billable optional services before publishing.

name: In-app feedback and changelog
description: Let mates report a reproducible issue and read what changed, without adding paid analytics or an external ticketing service.
